text:
maria: Dropping a concept for a 'Connection gate' step in the Private wizard. Focused on a single-line status with expandable diagnostics. Want copy + a11y + ops export options. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/priv-conn-gate

josh: Nice direction. A few rules of thumb: don't use passive verbs for CTAs (e.g., avoid 'Check'), prefer active like 'Run checks'. Include an ETA hint on the control: 'Runs in ~20s'.

aisha: Copy proposals for the status states:
- Green: "Connectivity verified" with small subcopy "Required ports and hosts reachable"
- Amber: "Partial — action recommended" with subcopy "Some ports blocked; expand for details"
- Red: "Blocked — fixes required" with subcopy "See troubleshooting steps or share with your network team"
Also: change the details trigger text from 'Show details' to 'View diagnostics' 1 clearer for ops.

lee: Accessibility checklist: status region should use role="status" and aria-live="polite" while running, and switch to aria-live="assertive" for failures. Make sure the expand/collapse is a button with aria-expanded toggled. Keyboard users must be able to open the diagnostics and copy rules without a mouse.

sam: On export formats: ops asked for three formats in the past: Compact (human-friendly list), Firewall CSV (src,dst,port,proto), and Full CIDR manifest. Suggest a small kebab menu next to copy: "Export: Compact / CSV / Full CIDRs". Default to Compact. Also add a tiny 'PDF' download for handing to on-prem network teams.

maria: Good call. For the CSV format, what column order do you want? Infra prefers port,proto,ip.

infra-bot: infra policy note: In CSV we need columns: service_name, port, protocol, cidr_list. Recommend limiting CIDR column to a semicolon-separated list to avoid CSV issues.

josh: UX note: show the actual rule preview (one-liner) next to each port so folks can quickly copy without opening export. Eg: "Control plane: tcp/443 -> 192.0.2.0/24,198.51.100.0/24". Also show a collapsed 'copy all' button.

aisha: Microcopy tweaks: rename the main heading to "Connection health & prerequisites" (consistent with docs). For the CTA on failures, use 'Action required: Fix and re-run' not just 'Retry'.

lee: Color contrast: current amber (#f5c758) looks fine for large labels but fails for body text. Ensure any text on colored chips meets 4.5:1 or use icons + labels. Also provide a high-contrast theme for the modal export view.

sam: For diagnostics modal include both the raw tool outputs and a short human summary. Example outputs to show in modal:
```
# tcp check
nc -vz api-customer.example 443
# http health
curl -I https://api-customer.example/healthz
```
and then below that a one-line summary: "3/4 ports reachable; control plane blocked".

maria: UX question: should the diagnostics auto-expand on failure? Ops likes it but might be noisy for success cases.

josh: Auto-expand only on failure. For success keep details collapsed but allow keyboard users to expand. Also expose a small 'R' keyboard shortcut hint: "Press R to re-run checks" next to the button (but ensure full accessible labeling).

aisha: Small wording change for the copy tooltip: instead of 'Copies to clipboard' use 'Copy firewall-ready rules'. More actionable.

infra-bot: compliance reminder: when exporting Full CIDRs, redact any internal-only ranges unless user has org-admin scope. Add a warning modal when selecting Full CIDRs if the workspace is not admin-owned.

maria: Noted. I'll add the admin warning and redaction logic. I'll also update Figma with: new heading, compact/CSV/Full export menu, status chips with icons, aria-live/role changes, auto-expand on failure, and keyboard shortcut hint. New figma link when ready.

sam: I'll start a short page in infra docs with CSV sample and a downloadable one-page PDF template for network teams.

josh: One last UX small thing: for partial failures include inline 'Try suggested fix' links (e.g., 'Open port 443 on load balancer') that expand into step snippets — saves a round trip to docs.

maria: Love it. Will prototype the inline fix snippets. Target: update by EOD and request a quick accessibility pass. Thanks all.
